asset.name: TimeMention
asset.description: Times, dates and durations written in prose, put into the reader's frame: their local time beside the original, a live countdown for deadlines, and a details card with the moment in every frame. Ships the grammar, resolver and remark plugin markdown renderers adopt.

requires.reason: The details card is an inline-anchored popover that becomes a sheet on narrow screens.
The UTC timestamp copies through the shared copy control.
Every sentence is a translatable string and dates format in the document locale.

rationale: Agents write times in their own frame — UTC, no date, relative to when they wrote — and readers convert them by hand. Detection is strict and frame-free so one markdown pass serves every renderer; resolution adds the reader's zone, now, and an optional send time, and anything that needs a missing frame falls back to the text as written.
